blocks.tamil_translation: O mankind! Remember the favour Allah has bestowed upon you. Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the sky and the earth? There is no god but He. So how are you being turned away (from Him)?

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (بَدِيعُ السَّموَاتِ وَاْلاَرْضِ ؕ أَنَّي يَكُونُ لَهُ وَلَدٌ وَّلَمْ تَكُنْ لَّهُ صَاحِبَةٌ ؕ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ ۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (He is) the Originator of the heavens and the earth without any prior model. How can He have a child when He has no wife? He created all things, and He has full knowledge of all things.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَّاتُمْنُونَ ۞ ءَأَنْتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْخلِقُونَ ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (Moreover) have you considered the (sperm) that you emit (into the womb)? Is it you who create it (into a child), or are We the Creator (of it)?

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ ۞ ءَأَنْتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الزَّارِعُونَ ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Have you considered what you sow (after ploughing the earth)? Is it you who make it grow, or are We the ones who make it grow?
